text:
sam: customer reported intermittent failures when bulk-ingesting embeddings into their vector DB. They use our Go SDK v0.5.4 with concurrency=8. About 1/15 batches fail with: "index mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024". They attached a minimal repro.

elena: can you paste the repro? also request ids so infra can trace.

sam: repro gist from customer (Go):```go
client := redwood.NewClient("$KEY")
chunks := chunkDocs(docs, 512)
var wg sync.WaitGroup
for _, c := range chunks {
  wg.Add(1)
  go func(batch []string){
    defer wg.Done()
    resp, _ := client.Embeddings.Create(ctx, redwood.CreateParams{Model:"embed-giant-v2", Input: batch})
    // they upsert resp.Data into Pinecone
  }(c)
}
wg.Wait()
```They say sometimes resp.Model == "embed-medium-v1" and embedding len == 1024.

tariq: that's a classic parallel chunk -> routing-change window. If the routing fallback can return a different-dim model mid-job you'll observe mixed dims. Do they log resp.Model in their upsert code?

sam: yes their logs show request ids: 2026-03-14:rq-a1, rq-a2, rq-a7. Example log snippet:```text
WARN upsert failed: dims mismatch idx=42 expected=1536 got=1024 request_id=rq-a2 returned_model=embed-medium-v1
INFO chunk rq-a1 ok returned_model=embed-giant-v2
```

elena: infra please follow rq-a2/ a7. We'll need to confirm whether router fallback occurred.

infra-bot: traced rq-a2 -> routed to embed-medium-v1 due to heavy load on embed-giant-v2 pool. Fallback policy allowed cross-dimension fallback.

elena: thanks. Short-term: we should give the customer concrete mitigations. Long-term: change fallback policy to avoid cross-dim fallbacks.

sam: customer is blocked because their index schema is fixed at 1536 dims. They want a hotfix to ensure model_requested == model_returned or immediate credit for failed upserts.

tariq: we can do two quick things: 1) add server header X-Embedding-Dimension and top-level field embedding_dimension in responses so clients can detect mismatch pre-upsert, 2) change fallback config to only fall back to models with the same embedding dimension. Both low-risk.

elena: agree. Also patch SDKs to surface returned model and dims in a machine-friendly place. Right now Go SDK returns resp.Model but no dims.

sam: can we give the customer workaround snippets? They are using Go, but include Python and TS examples.

elena: send this Go snippet to check dims before upsert:```go
resp, err := client.Embeddings.Create(ctx, params)
if err != nil { return err }
actualDim := len(resp.Data[0].Embedding)
if actualDim != expectedDim {
  return fmt.Errorf("embedding dimension mismatch: expected=%d got=%d returned_model=%s request_id=%s", expectedDim, actualDim, resp.Model, resp.RequestID)
}
// safe to upsert
```

sam: customer also noted timeouts: some chunk requests timed out after 6s, then retried and got different-dim responses. Their current SDK default timeout is 6s in Go.

tariq: change default timeout for embedding batch calls to 60s in all SDKs. Retries should be conservative: only retry on network errors or transient 5xx, and never retry blindly when response metadata mismatches.

qa: can we reproduce in staging? I can run a concurrency test that hits the router while throttling the giant pool and see if mixed dims are returned.

elena: yes please run a replay with the customer's request ids. Also test that header X-Embedding-Dimension is present after infra change.

infra-bot: PR opened: routing/avoid-cross-dim-fallback (#4310). CI queued. ETA: staging rollout in 6h. Additional PR: response/header/add-embed-dim (#4311).

sam: customer asks about billing for the failed upserts — charged for embeddings they did not store. Product?

elena: policy: billing is based on model actually served. If we served a lower-dim variant without clear notice, we can offer credits case-by-case. Please collect affected request_ids and escalate to billing.

sam: sent request ids to billing. Added note: customer uses Pinecone; they would accept a server-side hard reject when model_returned != model_requested if we can offer that as an option (strict_model:true).

tariq: that's a good product flag: client option strict_model (bool) that asks router to either honor exact model or return 409 if unavailable. Track as product ticket PD-#811.

elena: owners: infra to change fallback policy (tariq), SDKs to add dim guard + timeout changes (sam), support to coordinate billing and customer communications (sam).

support-bot: Can the customer provide minimal timestamps for rq-a1..a7 and SDK version? Also confirm whether they use a dedicated Redwood Dedicated account or hosted.

sam: they replied: hosted, Go SDK v0.5.4, timestamps included in logs.

qa: replayed traffic in staging with artificial pool pressure. Observed mixed dims when fallback allowed. With same-dim-only config, no mixed dims. Verified X-Embedding-Dimension header present in staging responses.

infra-bot: staging deployment of routing change successful. Prod rollout scheduled: 2026-03-16T11:00:00Z. Header rollout scheduled earlier: 2026-03-15T03:20:00Z.

sam: sent customer the header workaround and strict_model suggestion. Also suggested updating their upsert pipeline to validate dims and abort chunk on mismatch to avoid partially corrupted indexes.

tariq: small SDK behavioral notes: - Go SDK: return resp.RequestID and resp.EmbeddingDim at top level for quick checks - TS SDK: when chunking, attach metadata per item in resp.data[i].model and resp.data[i].embedding_length - Python SDK: add EmbeddingDimensionMismatch exception and logging hook.

elena: opened SDK tickets: GO-#99 add dims+requestID; TS-#271 per-item metadata; PY-#198 new exception and timeout change.

sam: customer accepted temporary workaround and requested ETA on prod fix. I gave them prod ETA and told them billing is in review.

infra-bot: prod routing change completed at 2026-03-16T11:02:14Z. Post-deploy checks: no mixed-dim responses in last 30m for the affected customer. Monitoring alert created: "mixed-embedding-dims-per-customer" with threshold >0.2%.

support-bot: ticket #9021 status -> resolved pending billing.

sam: closing thread after billing confirms credits/decision. Marking follow-ups: SDK rollouts and PD-#811 for strict_model flag. :white_check_mark:
